# seg-011
  ffmpeg
  -y
  -v
  error
  -i
  $WORK/recording/segments/seg-011.mp4
  -map
  0:v:0
  -map
  0:a?
  -vf
    scale=w=1080:h='max(if(between(t\,0.840\,1.000)\,(1920.000+(2073.600-1920.000)*(((t-0.840)/0.160)*((t-0.840)/0.160)*(3-2*((t-0.840)/0.160))))\,if(between(t\,1.000\,1.420)\,(2073.600+(1920.000-2073.600)*(((t-1.000)/0.420)*((t-1.000)/0.420)*(3-2*((t-1.000)/0.420))))\,1920))\,if(between(t\,2.590\,2.750)\,(1920.000+(2073.600-1920.000)*(((t-2.590)/0.160)*((t-2.590)/0.160)*(3-2*((t-2.590)/0.160))))\,if(between(t\,2.750\,3.170)\,(2073.600+(1920.000-2073.600)*(((t-2.750)/0.420)*((t-2.750)/0.420)*(3-2*((t-2.750)/0.420))))\,1920)))':force_original_aspect_ratio=increase:eval=frame:flags=lanczos+accurate_rnd+full_chroma_int
    crop=1080:1920:(iw-ow)/2:(ih-oh)/2
    setsar=1
    fps=60
    eq=contrast=1.180:saturation=1.280:gamma=1.020
    fade=t=out:st=4.650:d=0.100:color=white
    format=yuv420p
  -c:v
  libx264
  -preset
  slow
  -crf
  16
  -af
    loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11
  -c:a
  aac
  -b:a
  192k
  -movflags
  +faststart
  $WORK/render/short-001-seg-011.mp4

# seg-004
  ffmpeg
  -y
  -v
  error
  -i
  $WORK/recording/segments/seg-004.mp4
  -map
  0:v:0
  -map
  0:a?
  -vf
    scale=w=1080:h='max(if(between(t\,0.840\,1.000)\,(1920.000+(2073.600-1920.000)*(((t-0.840)/0.160)*((t-0.840)/0.160)*(3-2*((t-0.840)/0.160))))\,if(between(t\,1.000\,1.420)\,(2073.600+(1920.000-2073.600)*(((t-1.000)/0.420)*((t-1.000)/0.420)*(3-2*((t-1.000)/0.420))))\,1920))\,if(between(t\,1.949\,2.109)\,(1920.000+(2073.600-1920.000)*(((t-1.949)/0.160)*((t-1.949)/0.160)*(3-2*((t-1.949)/0.160))))\,if(between(t\,2.109\,2.529)\,(2073.600+(1920.000-2073.600)*(((t-2.109)/0.420)*((t-2.109)/0.420)*(3-2*((t-2.109)/0.420))))\,1920)))':force_original_aspect_ratio=increase:eval=frame:flags=lanczos+accurate_rnd+full_chroma_int
    crop=1080:1920:(iw-ow)/2:(ih-oh)/2
    setsar=1
    fps=60
    eq=contrast=1.180:saturation=1.280:gamma=1.020
    fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.100:color=white
    fade=t=out:st=7.009:d=0.100:color=white
    format=yuv420p
  -c:v
  libx264
  -preset
  slow
  -crf
  16
  -af
    loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11
  -c:a
  aac
  -b:a
  192k
  -movflags
  +faststart
  $WORK/render/short-002-seg-004.mp4
